subject: Microgrant request — one-time credit to finalize Novastack pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novastack.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novastack.io
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Quick ask — small credit top-up to complete pilot

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from our side — we ran into a throughput bottleneck during the regulatory demo run this morning and burned through our pilot allocation faster than expected. We're at ~72% of the test scenarios completed; a one-time top-up of ~25k tokens would let us finish the last validation and sign the PO by Oct 10.

If Redwood can grant a short, one-off credit (no change to pricing or committed terms), we can close this quarter — we have procurement lined up and legal cleared the standard SOW. Attaching our usage breakdown for context.

Appreciate a fast reply, we need to present final results to the board on Friday.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Engineering
Novastack
(attachment: novastack-usage-report.csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novastack.io>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick ask — small credit top-up to complete pilot

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and the report. I'm sorry to hear about the bottleneck; we want to help you finish the validation. I'll escalate internally and come back within the hour with what we can do.

Two quick Qs for the internal request: what is the minimum token top-up you need to complete the board demo (25k is fine, just confirming), and can you confirm the PO expected date?

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(hannah.schmitt@redwood.com)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Approval request: one-time microgrant for Novastack (NBX-202709-Q3-117)

Folks — forwarding an urgent ask from Novastack. TL;DR: Novastack requests a one-time 25,000 token credit to finish a regulatory demo and will convert to a paid PO (~$45k ARR) by Oct 10 if successful. Deal details in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/52345/NBX-202709-Q3-117.

Key data from the attachment (novastack-usage-report.csv):
- Pilot started: 2027-09-01
- Current usage: 75k tokens used of 100k allocation
- Remaining functional tests: ~6 scenarios (expected ~20k tokens)
- NRR opportunity: target purchase of reserved capacity (~$45k ARR)

Proposal: one-time 25k token microgrant, expiring 30 days after issue if no committed contract. Standard microgrant terms attached (microgrant-terms.pdf).

Requesting:
- Marissa: revenue sign-off for a discretionary 25k credit?
- Ben: finance confirmation we can offer this without altering invoice terms; also confirm if we need a PO requirement or DocuSign to accept the grant.

If approved, I'll send the client an email with the grant, expiration, and a DocuSign envelope for the acceptance form.

Thanks,
— Hannah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Approval request: one-time microgrant for Novastack (NBX-202709-Q3-117)

Hannah — I support this. Novastack has a solid conversion signal and the incremental ARR is meaningful for the quarter. Approve 25k conditional on:
1) The credits expire 30 days after issuance.
2) Client signs the microgrant acceptance (DocuSign) and confirms PO timing in writing.
3) We capture the usage pattern in the deal notes for QA/regression tracking.

Please proceed to finance for the formal greenlight.

— Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Approval request: one-time microgrant for Novastack (NBX-202709-Q3-117)

Confirmed from finance: we can approve a one-time 25k token credit under the conditions Marissa listed. Billing notes:
- No change to pricing/committed terms; this is a one-off marketing credit (non-refundable).
- Credit will be applied to the trial account; if consumption exceeds credit before signing, additional usage will be invoiced at standard pay-as-you-go rates.
- Require DocuSign acceptance prior to application.

I'll ask ops to prepare the internal ledger entry. Hannah — once you have the signed DocuSign, reply-all with the envelope ID and we will provision the credit.

— Ben

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novastack.io>
Cc: procurement@novastack.io, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 16:03:00 +0100
Subject: Approved: one-time 25k credit for Novastack pilot (Next steps)

Hi Liam — good news: we have internal approval for a one-time 25,000 token credit to help you finish the board demo. Conditions: the credit expires 30 days after issuance; client must sign the microgrant acceptance (DocuSign) and confirm PO timing; any usage beyond the credit will be billed at standard PAYG rates.

Please review and sign here: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123 (envelope: docusign-novastack-credit.pdf). Once signed, we'll apply the credit (ops will provision within 2 hours) and I'll update the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/52345/NBX-202709-Q3-117.

Attachments: microgrant-terms.pdf (terms), novastack-usage-report.csv (for reference).

Thanks for moving quickly — excited to get you across the finish line.

Best,
